How about {{Color SSHD|Red|20}}?|Peatrice|SSHD}} }} |location= {{Spawn Locations}} |uses= Defense |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 2 |TotK= 2 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 12 |TotK= 12 }} |comp= {{List| * [[Fighter's Shield|Small Shield]] * [[Deku Shield]] * [[Ordon Shield]] * [[Small Shield]] }} |sample= |theme= }} '''Wooden Shields''', also known as '''Strange Boards''', are recurring [[Item]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. These [[Shield]]s are usually unable to protect against [[Fire]] and magical attacks, and may even be burnt by them. The Wooden Shield is usually superseded by a stronger, metallic Shield. {{Terminology |- | {{Term/Store|Wooden Shield|Wooden Shields|Series, OoS, OoA, TP, TPHD, SS, BotW, TotK}} | {{List| * {{OoS}} * {{OoA}} * {{TP}} * {{TPHD}} * {{SS}} * {{SSHD}}{{Name Ref|SSHD}} * {{BotW}} * {{TotK}} }} |- | '''Strange Board''' | {{OoA}} |- | ''No name is given'' | {{List| * {{HWL}} * {{HWDE}} * {{AoC}} }} }} ==Location and Uses== {{TWW Item Properties/Store |type = Wooden Shield }} ==={{OoS|-}}=== In {{OoS}}, the Wooden Shield is the first [[Shield]] that [[Link]] can obtain. It can be upgraded to the [[Iron Shield]] and later the [[Mirror Shield]] through a [[Linked Game]]. Wooden Shields can be bought for 30 [[Rupee]]s from the [[Horon Village Shop]]. ==={{OoA|-}}=== {{Stub|OoA}} In {{OoA}}, the Wooden Shield is the first [[Shield]] that [[Link]] can get. Wooden Shields can be bought for 30 [[Rupee]]s in the [[Lynna Item Shop]], or from [[Business Scrub]]s for varying amounts of Rupees.{{Fact|OoA}} In a [[Linked Game]], Impa gives Link a Wooden Shield at the start of the adventure instead of the [[Wooden Sword]], which he already has. ==={{TP|-}}=== In {{TP}}, Wooden Shields can be bought at [[Malo Mart]] in [[Kakariko Village]] or the [[Goron Shop#Twilight Princess|Hot Spring Shop]] on [[Death Mountain]]. They serve as replacements to the one-of-a-kind and flammable [[Ordon Shield]], the first Shield Link obtains. Wooden Shields are larger than the Ordon Shield and have metal trims, but are functionally identical and may also catch on fire. If it catches fire, the Wooden Shield can be saved by putting it away. Like the Ordon Shield, the Wooden Shield is able to block and subsequently catch Arrows, a feature that [[Hylian Shield]]s are incapable of. ==={{PH|-}}=== In {{PH}}, the Wooden Shield is the only Shield available. It can be purchased early on at [[Mercay Island Shop]] for 80 [[Rupee]]s, and is also available at [[Molida Island Shop]] and [[Goron Island Shop]] for the same price. Once purchased, it becomes unavailable at all stores unless it is eaten by a [[Like Like]]. In order to improve his defense, Link must use [[Neri]]'s powers to improve the Shield's capabilities, such as blocking more projectiles and stunning enemies that run into the Shield. The Shield also appears in {{ST}}, known as the [[Shield of Antiquity]], where it cannot be eaten by Like Likes. ==={{SS|-}}=== In {{SS}}, the Wooden Shield can be obtained from [[Owlan]] by talking to him after obtaining the [[Goddess Sword]].{{Cite|I heard the news, Link! Zelda's fallen down through the clouds and you're going to look for her. Is that right? The headmaster told me there's land beneath the clouds... Do you know anything about that? So that's the famous sword... Ah, but it won't do you much good if you don't have a shield to protect yourself with! Here--take this with you!|Owlan|SS}} It can also be bought from the [[Gear Shop]] at the [[Skyloft Bazaar]] for 50 [[Rupee]]s. It is the most basic Shield in the game. It is weak to fire and will burn up if Link falls into lava.{{Cite|Also, keep in mind that it's particularly vulnerable to fire.|Owlan|SS}} However, it is immune to electric attacks, making it useful in the [[Lanayru Desert]]. The Shield's special property is that it will not only block enemy Arrows, but also enable Link to collect any of them that are lodged into it; however, while a well-timed [[Shield Bash]] will protect it from most fire-based attacks, a flaming Arrow will make it start to burn. By trading [[Gondo]] some Rupees and [[Treasure]], Link can [[Upgrading|upgrade]] the Wooden Shield at the [[Scrap Shop]]. Despite their increased durability, they still retain their weakness to fire. ====Upgrades==== {{Upgrades|SS|Wooden Shield}} ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 2 |durability = 12 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Wooden Shield}} Wooden Shields are simple [[Shield]]s in {{BotW}}. They have low defensive power, but they are known to be ideal for less-experienced fighters. They are able to withstand lighter attacks, but it is not recommended to block stronger blows with them. They are found either abandoned or wielded by low-tier [[Enemy|Enemies]] in [[Hyrule Field]] and [[East Necluda]]. [[Russ]] sells a Wooden Shield on [[Trilby Plain]] for 30 [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|The wooden shield? A decent choice for shield surfing, sure. How's about {{Color BotW|Red|30 rupees}}?|Russ|BotW}} When [[Link]] buys it, Russ will encourage him to try [[Shield Surfing]] with it.{{Cite|Rock solid, man! You just gotta shred it up and you'll be sold for life!|Russ|BotW}} While renting a [[Sand Seal]], [[Frelly]] will give Link a Wooden Shield if he pays 50 Rupees.{{Cite|It's only {{Color BotW|Red|20 rupees}} to rent one! Need a shield, too? Just pay {{Color BotW|Red|50 rupees}}! What do you say?|Frelly|BotW}} [[Selmie]] will also reward Link with a Wooden Shield if he completes the Advanced Course of the [[Shield-Surfing (Mini-Game)|Shield-Surfing]] [[Mini-Game]] in over 3:30.{{Cite|A shiny new record deserves a shiny new shield. Here y'go!|Selmie|BotW}} Being made of wood, Wooden Shields will burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. Finally, they are unable to be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_001" |Life = 12 |GuardPower = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 8 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 2 |durability = 12 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Wooden Shield}} {{Stub|TotK}} Wooden Shields reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{HWL|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub}} In {{HWL}}, the Wooden Shield from {{PH|-}} appears along with the [[Phantom Sword]] as part of [[Toon Link]]'s Sword weapon set. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Wooden Shields can be wielded by Link in conjunction with [[Tree Branch]]es, [[Boomerang]]s, [[Bokoblin Arm]]s, or [[Lizalfos Arm]]s.
